receipt_artifact_hash.input: the complete accepted receipt JSON object, including receipt_signature
receipt_artifact_hash.output: lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest, no prefix
receipt_artifact_hash.purpose: Binds the exact complete receipt object delivered to the verifier. Stable across JSON member insertion order (RFC8785-JCS canonicalizes key order); changes if any receipt field changes, including signature metadata.

receipt_signature_verification.input_contract: the complete receipt JSON object with the receipt_signature.signature member deleted; every other receipt_signature member (algorithm, canonicalization, key_id) is retained in the signed preimage
receipt_signature_verification.verified_against: the Ed25519 public key resolved from the trust bundle by receipt_signature.key_id
receipt_signature_verification.distinct_from_receipt_artifact_hash: This preimage excludes receipt_signature.signature, so it is a strict subset of the bytes hashed by receipt_artifact_hash. A receipt can therefore have a valid signature and a receipt_artifact_hash that nonetheless changes if only the signature bytes themselves change (e.g. a legitimate re-signature over identical semantic content would need a matching signature, but an ALTERED signature value flips receipt_artifact_hash and signature_valid together).
receipt_signature_verification.implementation: arcs_verify.verifier.verify_receipt (existing governed path; not reimplemented by this contract)

trust_bundle_digest.input: the complete trust-bundle JSON object supplied as --keyring for this invocation
trust_bundle_digest.output: lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest, no prefix
trust_bundle_digest.purpose: Records the exact trust artifact used for verification. Does not by itself assert that the trust bundle was authorized; a later exporter/consumer contract establishes that.

input_object.envelope_schema_sha256: the FROZEN_SCHEMA_SHA256 constant pinned in arcs_verify/verifier.py
input_object.receipt_version: the RECEIPT_VERSION constant pinned in arcs_verify/verifier.py
input_object.selected_profile: the --profile value used for this invocation

verifier_configuration_digest.output: lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest, no prefix

verification_report_digest.input: the complete deterministic verification report JSON object defined by verification-report.schema.json
verification_report_digest.output: lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest, no prefix
verification_report_digest.purpose: Binds a verification execution record to the exact report it asserts it produced.

rfc8785_conformance_note: The rfc8785 dependency (pinned exactly at rfc8785==0.1.4 in pyproject.toml) implements RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme, not merely recursively key-sorted JSON. It is the same dependency already used by arcs_verify.verifier for the Ed25519 signature preimage, and its conformance is exercised by the frozen vectors under vendor/arcs-srs/vectors/rfc8785/.
